items.snippet: For backward compatibility, the math module provides also aliases of the following functions from the math.integer module: Added in version 3.5: The gcd() function.

items.title: Python math.gcd() Method
items.snippet: ❮ Previous Python Math Module Reference Next ❯ · Find the greatest common divisor of the two integers: #Import math Library import math #find the the greatest common divisor of the two integers print (math.gcd(3, 6)) print (math.gcd(6, 12)) print (math.gcd(12, 36)) print (math.gcd(-12, -36)) print (math.gcd(5, 12)) print (math.gcd(10, 0)) print (math.gcd(0, 34)) print (math.gcd(0, 0)) Try it Yourself »
